referents.why: 'this is the finger of God' points at the gnat plague; no candidate in the list names the plague, and the feminine copula agrees with the predicate, not the subject
referents.category: demonstrative for an event not among candidates

referents.why: 3mp object 'them' is the magicians who spoke to Pharaoh
3ms 'he would not listen' is Pharaoh; the heart cannot listen, and the builder's heart is the seat of the will, not its agent

links.why: ka'asher, just as, with the clause he had said nested in its prepositional role
cl0 is the frame that opens the verse; the then-link runs the wrong way
cl1 is inside the magicians' speech; a wayyiqtol continues the narrative from the nearest clause outside speech, which is cl0
wayyiqtol continues the narrative line from the frame of the speech, the nearest clause not inside a speech
a will hardened, then the refusal that follows, is result, not a plain and
Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and so he would not listen: the refusal is what the hardening brings about
they said introduces the words This is the finger of God

groups.why: the magicians speak the words to Pharaoh; the speech is cl1

cant_tell.what: as the LORD had said (the compared saying in cl4)
cant_tell.why: it is an earlier word of the LORD that is not in this passage, so the fulfilment cannot point to a clause here
